help: Series form matrix rows; coordinate labels form columns. Each cell keeps its numerical value. Thresholds are inclusive upper bounds, ordered from lowest to highest; the final band covers all larger values. Missing cells are shown separately.
label: Band label
invalid: Give each threshold a label and colour, use increasing finite upper bounds, and end with an unbounded band.
matrixInvalid: Heatmaps need category coordinates and one value per row/column pair. Use at most 100 rows and 100 columns. Uncertainty and annotations belong in a separate measurement plot.
